newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end sharply higher.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended sharply higher on Tuesday, backed by price rises in other commodity futures and the yen"s weaker tendency against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 4.7 yen to 6.1 yen per kg higher. Most-active benchmark July was up 5.7 yen at 161.7 yen.

"Although there was little fresh news to prop up prices, gains in other commodity futures, such as precious metals and grain futures, encouraged individual investors to buy," an analyst at a commodity brokerage said.
